description: De-identification register (PIA §3/§5). The machine-readable record of what the optional research contribution collects, how each field is de-identified or aggregated before/at storage, the geography scope it is held at, the minimum-group-size (k) suppression applied on publication, and its retention. Bound to the deployed research payload schema version so a schema change forces a re-assessment. Validated fail-closed by scripts/check-privacy-claims.mjs and cross-checked against RESEARCH_SCHEMA_VERSION (apps/web/src/lib/research/consent.ts), SENSITIVE_DIMENSIONS (apps/web/src/lib/survey.ts) and MIN_CELL (packages/data-pipeline/src/stats.ts). The external de-identification assessment that classifies the published aggregates as non-personal is EV-DEIDENTIFICATION-ASSESSMENT (pending) — the control stays partial until it is signed.
retentionNote: The store holds only genuinely aggregated group counts (not personal information), so there is no fixed maximum period; aggregates are reviewed after each federal election and retired on a purpose basis (docs/privacy/retention.md; ADR-0008). No timestamp finer than a calendar quarter is stored anywhere.

coreControls.description: The raw ~50-item answer vector and importance weights are reduced to a top-party match and a per-proposition agree/neutral/disagree stance ON THE DEVICE; the raw vector never leaves the browser. Only the derived values are transmitted (transport allowlist).

Each contribution is tallied into cohort-keyed aggregate counters via an atomic UPSERT; no per-person row exists at rest, and nothing records that a batch's increments came from one request (no delta log, no insertion-order key, no shared token).
The electorate is split onto its own unlinkable request (/api/research/geography) and held only as a running integer tally; no counter pairs an electorate with any result or survey answer.
No counter keys an opinion value (party match / stance) together with a sensitive attribute AND a sub-national geography; sensitive dimensions are stored national-only (state key '').
Published aggregates are k-suppressed at the database/view layer (HAVING SUM(n) >= k, k = 10), with complementary suppression against national/state differencing and no electorate-level result.

fields.name: match
fields.note: Top-party match derived on device (never a raw answer vector). Party-by-demographic counters keep sensitive dimensions national-only.

fields.name: propositions.stance
fields.note: Per-answered-proposition agree/neutral/disagree only — never the raw label, points value or importance weight.

fields.name: state
fields.note: State/territory only; never the electorate (that is split onto the geography endpoint).

fields.name: electorate
fields.note: Sent as its own unlinkable request; stored only as an incrementing tally with nothing attached (no result, no survey answer, no date).

fields.name: demographics
fields.note: Allowlisted categorical values only (survey.ts DEMOGRAPHIC_OPTIONS); every item has a prefer-not-to-say option; sensitive dimensions (SENSITIVE_DIMENSIONS) are stored national-only.

fields.name: consentVersion
fields.note: Recorded in aggregate (consent_count) so the exact notice consented to is known; a payload without a valid consent version is dropped.

fields.name: collectionPeriod
fields.note: Calendar quarter only (AEST). No timestamp finer than a quarter is stored anywhere; no per-request date is parsed.

evidence.description: External de-identification assessment tied to the deployed schema version: confirmation that derive-on-device + the national-only key rule + k=10 cell suppression + complementary/differencing controls render the collected data and published aggregates non-personal. Implementation and tests are complete; the control stays partial (fail-closed) until this assessment is signed.
